create_ValueStats_feed_values: create a ValueStats instance and feed numeric values to track running min, max, and mean statistics
create_MultiCounter_track_counts: create a MultiCounter with an optional TensorBoard root directory to track event counts and value statistics
use_MultiCounter_inc_key: use MultiCounter.inc to increment a named counter and track total event counts across keys
use_MultiCounter_summary: use MultiCounter.summary to print elapsed time, key counts, and per-key value statistics to console and TensorBoard
reset_MultiCounter_stats: reset all MultiCounter statistics and counters while preserving the stats dictionary structure for reuse
